notes: Numbers from arXiv v1 (2507.14724v1, 4 pages; page-1 footer reads (c)2024 The Author(s), venue not stated in the source). cladding: SiO2 with 5 um wide oxide opening; FN-LC (pm-158) infiltrated
epitaxy_or_stack: 220 nm undoped Si core, one-sided 90 nm n-Si slab (3e17 cm-3) to n++ (1e20 cm-3) contact; ring radius 40 um; FN-LC pm-158
notes: Numbers from arXiv v1 (2602.20406v1, 16 pages, 23 Feb 2026); journal version (Optica 13(7) 1368, issued 2026-07-15, print 2026-07-20) not read. Coupling loss is reported separately for the PIC (average about 12 dB per photonic-wire-bond channel, about 10.5 dB per grating coupler, p.7); the definition of the 0.78 dB is not stated. Resonance near 1534.5 nm (Fig. 3(c)); operating wavelength not stated, wavelength_nm left empty. Phase-shifter length not stated; ring radius 40 um; V_pi L uses ring circumference. Single GSG-fed ring; RF and DC bias on the same electrodes; drive left unspecified (convention (f) is defined for MZM arms). Two phase-shift mechanisms: slow birefringence response (f-6dB 119 kHz, strong) and fast Pockels response (f-6dB 7.8 GHz, about 30 dB weaker in S21); DC tuning 150 pm/V (abstract, text, Fig. 3(e)) vs 250 pm/V (Fig. 3(c) caption). Fig. 3(c) graphic also annotates about 0.65 dB off-resonance loss and FWHM about 150 pm at 1534.5 nm (Q about 10k by arithmetic), versus 0.78 dB and Q 15340 in caption and abstract; the paper is internally inconsistent on IL, FWHM/Q and tuning efficiency, and the caption/abstract values are entered. Vpi, V_pi L and tuning efficiency are DC/slow (about 119 kHz) birefringence-dominated values, not the 7.8 GHz Pockels response that bw6db_ghz refers to. Static power 4.77 nW/pi (text, = V_pi x 0.36 nA) vs 4.5 nW/pi (abstract). AC drive 2.83 Vpp (S21 measurement); ER at 7.8 GHz called modest, value not stated. Fig. 6 caption lists 'experimentally obtained' eta_ps 0.69e-5 /V, Vpp 368 V and f-3dB 2.1 GHz that are not consistent with the main text; not used. 3 dB bandwidth not reported. Footprint about 0.084 mm2 (8400 um2). Fabricated at Advanced Micro Foundry (DUV, SOI); FN-LC (pm-158, Polaris Electro-Optics) hand-coated post-foundry; no passivation step in the PIC demo.

device_label: 600 um n-InGaAsP/Si hybrid MOS phase shifter
il_onchip_includes: carrier-induced excess loss at pi (0.20 dB) plus two Si-to-hybrid tapers (0.18 dB each)
il_onchip_excludes: fiber and edge-coupler loss (section total only); baseline normalization defined in Supplementary Sections IV-V (not read)
substrate: 300 mm SOI wafer, Si waveguides embedded in SiO2 and planarized (CMP); III-V grown on InP substrate
epitaxy_or_stack: p-Si rib / 8.1 nm Al2O3 + 16 nm SiO2 (EOT 19.2 nm, TEM) / 200 nm n-InGaAsP / 20 nm n-InP / 100 nm n++-InGaAs; wafer bonded with Al2O3
notes: Numbers from arXiv v1 (2609.24611v1, 10 pages, 21 Sep 2026); Supplementary Sections I-IX are not in the cached source. Phase-shifting mechanism is carrier accumulation and depletion (plasma dispersion, band filling, Franz-Keldysh) in n-InGaAsP, not Pockels; eo_material=other. VpiL 0.13 V*cm measured on 500 and 1000 um phase shifters (Fig. 2(d)); Vpi 2.2 V is quoted for 600 um without stating how it was obtained (not described as a measurement); consistent with 0.13 V*cm / 0.6 mm = 2.17 V. Wavelength 1550 nm. Fig. 2(e) MZI with 1.1 mm phase shifter shows more than 2 pi tuning (gate -1 to 5 V). Dynamic: 10-90% rise 555 ps and fall 417 ps, 9.375 MHz square wave, 2.0 Vpp on 3.0 V bias (Fig. 2(f)), device length not stated; RC-limited; no S21 bandwidth reported. Static power 28.9 fW/pi (13.3 fA leakage, 600 um); circuit median 21.8 fW; switching energy 15.3 pJ/pi (C = 6.48 pF); not mapped to energy_per_bit_fj (per pi, not per bit). Carrier-induced excess loss 0.20 dB/pi; taper loss 0.18 dB each; il_onchip_db is the section total at pi, loss reference and normalization defined in Supplementary Sections IV-V (not read). Circuit: 4x4 Clements mesh, channel crosstalk below -12 dB, 50 random unitaries R2 0.93, negligible thermal crosstalk. MZI internal and external phase-shifter pairs operated push-pull in the circuit. Phase-shifter drive mode, ER and rib width not reported.
